purpose: Session bootstrap for WebFunctionalEnv(setup_actions=...). Replayed at the start of every episode, before the first observation, and not counted against the step budget.
why: Every episode starts from a fresh browser context, so without this the agent must re-discover and re-complete the login form each time — and random exploration essentially never fills three fields and submits, so it never gets past it at all.

That is not only an exploration cost. Most of Gitea's declared constraints (services/forms/user_form.go) govern forms that only exist behind a session, so an anonymous corpus cannot exercise them, and the declared-constraints half of source grounding cannot be tested against it.
credentials: Matches scripts/setup_gitea.py (ADMIN_USER / ADMIN_PASSWORD). These are throwaway credentials for a local disposable container and are deliberately in the repo so the bootstrap is reproducible; never point this file at anything real.
